basic_information.official_title: AN ACT CREATING AND ESTABLISHING THE PURA MUNICIPAL HOSPITAL IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF DATU BLAH T. SINSUAT, PROVINCE OF MAGUINDANAO DEL NORTE, BANGSAMORO AUTONOMOUS REGION IN MUSLIM MINDANAO, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
signed_by: Prof. Raby B. Angkal, Secretary General
basic_information.effectivity: 15 days after full publication in a newspaper of general circulation in the BARMM
basic_information.title_note: The act's own short title calls it the “Pura Municipal Hospital Act of 2022”, although it was passed in December 2024 and approved in January 2025. The registry records the short title as enacted.

citizen_summary.what_is_this_about: Creates the Pura Municipal Hospital in Barangay Pura, Datu Blah T. Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte — at least 25 beds, serving the municipality and the coastal areas around it.
citizen_summary.why_was_it_proposed: The Organic Law duty to provide comprehensive and integrated health service delivery and establish a general hospital system by law.
citizen_summary.what_will_change: A hospital is created with at least 25 beds to national DOH minimum standards, expressly available to patients from adjacent municipalities, especially the coastal areas of Maguindanao del Norte.
who_will_be_affected: Residents of Datu Blah T. Sinsuat — the municipality BAA 90 would rename West Upi
Patients from adjacent municipalities, especially coastal areas
Existing medical facilities the hospital is to augment and support
citizen_summary.when_will_it_take_effect: In force since 2025 — 15 days after full publication.

key_provisions: Section 1 — Short title: the “Pura Municipal Hospital Act of 2022”.

Section 2 — Policy grounded on Section 22, Article IX of the Organic Law: comprehensive and integrated health service delivery, a general hospital system established by law, and the basic right to life made attainable through prompt intervention of excellent and affordable medical services.
Section 3 — Creates the Pura Municipal Hospital (PMH) in Barangay Pura, Municipality of Datu Blah T. Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte.

Section 4 — The hospital shall have at least 25 beds following the minimum national standards and guidelines of the Department of Health, and shall be equipped and operated accordingly. Future upgrades to expand capacity are considered on evaluations and recommendations by the Ministry of Health.

Section 5 — The hospital serves primarily but not exclusively patients from Datu Blah T. Sinsuat, and may extend its services as augmentation and support to other existing medical facilities, particularly for patients from adjacent municipalities, especially the coastal areas of Maguindanao del Norte.

Section 6 — Objectives: highly accessible, affordable and comprehensive healthcare services including hospital care, and integration of all relevant provisions of Republic Act 11223, the Universal Health Care Act.
Section 7 — The hospital is under the administrative supervision of the Ministry of Health, which determines and approves its organisational structure.

Section 8 — An initial ₱50,000,000 is charged against the Miscellaneous and Personnel Benefit Fund of the 2025 General Appropriation Act of the Bangsamoro, with later operations included in the annual appropriations.
Section 10 — Repeals inconsistent BARMM laws, including those enacted by the defunct ARMM Government, on the construction, establishment and operations of the hospital.
Section 11 — Takes effect 15 days after full publication in a newspaper of general circulation in the BARMM.

related_legislation.related_note: Passed with BAA 66, 68 and 69 on 12 December 2024. The host municipality, Datu Blah T. Sinsuat, would be renamed West Upi by BAA 90 subject to a plebiscite; its district hospital was separately upgraded by BAA 25.

citizen_questions.a: At least 25 beds, following minimum national Department of Health standards. Future upgrades depend on Ministry of Health evaluation.

citizen_questions.q: Can I use it if I live in the next municipality?
citizen_questions.a: Yes. Section 5 says the hospital serves primarily but not exclusively Datu Blah T. Sinsuat, and may extend services to adjacent municipalities, especially coastal areas.

citizen_questions.q: How much money, and from where?
citizen_questions.a: An initial ₱50 million from the Miscellaneous and Personnel Benefit Fund of the 2025 Bangsamoro budget.

The short title as enacted reads “Pura Municipal Hospital Act of 2022”, although Parliament passed it in December 2024 and it was approved in January 2025. The registry records the title as enacted rather than correcting it.
